residual_risks: Pending-reply disconnect retention on Linux: LocalServer.cpp:59 stops both further request reading and the incomplete-request timer; LocalIpc.cpp:135 disables the sole read notifier while the write notifier remains disabled until a reply needs drainage. A client that fully closes during this phase is not observed until sendAndClose/flush or explicit server teardown, so LocalServer.cpp:52 cannot promptly remove it from the 64-client set. Public OperationService.cpp:33-35,194-195 and SettingsService.cpp:138-155 confirm real asynchronous disk/journal reply paths. The frozen root-supplied Qt6.4.2 probe observed original Qt disconnected=1 and native disconnected=0 before any reply (native red after 3.036s); this is author-run narrow transport evidence, not independently executed production or 64-slot saturation proof. The peer confidence remains 50 and the broader saturation/activation cascade is unmeasured. Preserve full-close monitoring without treating SHUT_WR as a full close, then verify the pending-reply and half-close scenarios before relying on prompt slot recovery.
testing_gaps: Pending-reply abort regression: tests/integration/test_local_ipc.cpp:47-53 schedules a reply after 30ms and checks subsequent requests; it never asserts disconnected before that reply or admission-slot recovery. Add a synthetic held-reply case that aborts after stopReading and requires disconnected before reply, plus a LocalServer-level case requiring the accepted-client budget to recover while dispatch is pending. The supplied external differential red probe covers only the transport signal and is not this committed production-path regression.

Half-close composition regression: tests/integration/test_local_ipc.cpp:82-86 uses an immediate test-only LocalIpcServer reply. Add a complete newline JSON request with SHUT_WR through real LocalServer framing/handled/deadline, hold its asynchronous reply, and require that reply to arrive; also distinguish a later full peer close so any disconnect-monitoring fix does not discard supported half-closed requests.
